name: Naruse Takuto
source:
Favorite series: None in particular.

Takuto is a second year high school student and classmates with [url=/c75371]Rio[/url], [url=/c75586]Kyouya[/url] and [url=/c75367]Azusa[/url]. He's a pretty hardcore otaku who is in love with 2D girls. With Rio, he is the founding member of a game guild; just like Rio, he wants Kyouya to join it. He talks quite easily with his close friends and other boys but quickly loses his temper in front of girls he doesn't know.
